scriptComments: These 3 mean whenever a new round starts, main menu is on, or the game over screen is on, the laser will simply be hidden.
This means that, unlike the peas, the laser will keep moving forward untill it hits the edge, no matter how many rocks it flies into.

This means it will point in the direction the plant is facing and move fast in that direction. The "move 8 steps" means it will fly faster than a regular pea (5 steps)If you're reading this, you can change the number if you want, but 8 is the recommended speed. 1 being extremely sluggish, 10 being extremely speedy.
This short script tells the laser to go back to what plant it was shot by and repeat it's proccess of doing so.
